smmu_descriptors_t

A master aggregation structure containing all in-memory tables required by the SMMUv3 controller.

This massive structure holds the linear Stream Table, Context Descriptors, the Command Queue, Event Queue, and the fully populated multi-level translation page tables for both the 512MB (SDM) and 1TB (Peripheral) virtual address spaces.  By defining this as a single struct, the driver ensures all required alignment boundaries (e.g., 4KB page bounds, 64-byte cache lines) are strictly honored by the linker during bare-metal instantiation.
